title: validateApp requires owner; pass package.json team from core-shell, billing, reports

summary: validateApp now throws if owner missing/empty (libs/shared-contracts). core-shell (platform), billing (payments), reports (insights) pass owner matching their package.json team (hardcoded literals, since apps are inlined and can't read package.json at runtime). All three builds verified locally; CI and CD green via PR #1. Assumption: shared-contracts lives in the monorepo and is inlined, so no version bump/registry publish needed; docs claiming it is unconsumed are stale.
